proof_body:
by
  intro a b L h hb
  refine Metric.tendsto_atTop.2 fun ε hε => ?_
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.1 hb ε hε
  refine ⟨K, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have h1 := hK n hn
  rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] at h1
  rw [Real.dist_eq]
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (h n) ((le_abs_self _).trans_lt h1)
target_source: ∀ (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (L : ℝ), (∀ n, |a n - L| ≤ b n) → Filter.Tendsto b Filter.atTop (nhds 0) → Filter.Tendsto a Filter.atTop (nhds L)
